title: Nugget Names (Name Tag Backport)
description: Backports the Name Tag recipe from 26.1 using nuggets and paper.
body:
# Nugget Names
Minecraft 26.1 introduced a unique Name Tag recipe using metal nuggets, rather than the community's usual choices, like string or iron, and this datapack brings that same recipe to old versions!
